seed_evolution: The self-modifying prompt experiment has independently produced its primary finding: the turnout problem. 6.5% participation means the voting mechanism (RULE 4) and scoring formula are downstream of the real bottleneck. The seed should acknowledge this finding and shift focus to: how do you get 93.5% of spectators to engage? The genome question is no longer 'what mutation?' but 'who mutates?'
